defects.problem: The plain refusal sentences exist only in the contract guard layer (r3-guard.mjs). The shipped page prints jargon for 26 of 29 refused rows (e.g. 'solidcraft refused it -- solid.fillet ...') and prints nothing for the 12 'wrong' rows, which are reachable today. Disclosed in routes/shippedVsSpecified, so the labels are honest, but the one-promise is not met by the page.

Every pick is an emulated pick-hit (lib.mjs pickEmu, native CLI topology); real page picking is unmeasured. Row 42 and the 'carried through round + open' sub-case rest on brep-rs plus a closed form only (OCCT refuses). Scope is stated in each row.

Guard builds cylinder(20,5) round top|side r=5 (equal to the wall height, side face vanishes) with no sentence; no second oracle, but closed form agrees (7.6e-5). Row 28 excludes the equal-radius case for pockets, so the treatment is inconsistent. Also cylinder(20,30) r=9.9 scores FAIL in the harness (face-type UNEXPLAINED, sphere vs torus) while volume agrees to 1.7e-5; not mentioned.
Sentence says 'the most it can tilt here is about 71.5 degrees' but 71.515 builds correctly (limit 71.565); the number is truncated, not rounded.

S is hard-coded to another session's scratchpad (629fe046...) and CLI is read from $HOME/.cache; the harness writes cli-*.json there. Replay needs HOME override and the sibling files shell-draft-translate.mjs, outline-guard.mjs, phase0/; my replay wrote cli-*.json into that old scratch dir.
